results.reader_title: Beyond vulnerability: When trade dependence fuels stability
results.reader_what: Trade dependence on a dominant partner can sometimes reduce growth volatility, including in European economies.
results.reader_why: Dependence is not uniformly destabilising; partner structure can alter the resilience consequences of concentrated trade ties.
results.reader_more: Trade dependence on a dominant partner can sometimes reduce growth volatility, including in European economies. Cross-country empirical analysis linking largest-partner trade dependence to growth volatility, with regional heterogeneity including Europe. Dependence is measured through dominant trade-partner shares; the stabilising association is heterogeneous and does not imply coercive risk disappears.
